articles.title: Shubman Gill-designed Fazilka Falcons jersey unveiled in father Lakhwinder’s presence ahead of 2026 Sher-E-Punjab T20 League

articles.body: Shubman Gill's presence added a special touch to the jersey launch of Fazilka Falcons ahead of the Sher-E-Punjab T20 League 2026.The India captain, who will lead the Fazilka-based side, personally designed the team's jersey, while the kit was unveiled at an event in Chandigarh.The jersey launch became a family moment with Gill's father Lakhwinder Singh Gill among those present for the unveiling. The design draws inspiration from Punjab's culture, traditions and heritage while giving the team a modern identity.Fazilka Falcons owner Khushpreet Singh Aulakh said the involvement of Gill made the jersey particularly meaningful.“Today is a very special occasion for Fazilka Falcons and for everyone associated with the team. Having Shubman Gill personally design the jersey makes it even more meaningful because it brings together cricket and the rich culture of Punjab. The design reflects the pride, traditions and spirit of our state, while also giving the team a strong identity of its own,” he said.Falcons ready for inaugural campaignThe jersey was unveiled on National Sports Day, adding significance to an event celebrating sport and athletes. The Falcons will feature a combination of experienced players and young talent, with Gill leading the team in the inaugural season.“For the people of Punjab, this jersey is not just a team kit, it represents our culture, our passion for cricket and the dreams of the young players who will be taking the field. We are proud to unveil it on National Sports Day and hope the people of Punjab connect with the jersey and proudly support the Fazilka Falcons throughout the tournament,” Aulakh added.The Sher-E-Punjab T20 League will begin on August 30 and run until September 13 at the I.S. Bindra Stadium in Mohali, with six teams competing across 27 matches.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.
